text.p: These were the main headlines on Latvia's state radio at noon. Reuters has not verified these reports and does not vouch for their accuracy.

- State health minister Juris Vinkelis and state education minister Juris Celminsh were found formally to have broken the anti-corruption law by holding state and private posts at the same time but the prosecutor's office does not intend to bring criminal charges.
- Parliament is considering changes to the 1997 budget that sets aside more funds for health, social and cultural areas.
- The economy ministry is to publish a new report on the health of the economy.
- President Ulmanis met EU ambassadors to discuss the EU Amsterdam summit.
- Pre-Ligo parties are planned at the Kipsala centre.
